---
title: "One-page brief template"
subtitle: "Module 4"
---

Use this structure for the Day 5 brief. One page, plain language.

```markdown
# Genomic investigation brief — <title>
Date · Author · Data version

## Key message (2 sentences)
What is the answer to the question? How confident are you?

## Question asked
...

## Data and quality
N genomes received, N analysed, N excluded (why). Reference used. Negative controls.

## Findings
1. Lineages and where they occur
2. Relationships between clusters / regions
3. Timing

## Figure
(tree or timeline, with caption)

## Interpretation and confidence
What the data support / do not support. Alternative explanations.

## Limits
Sampling, resolution, missing data.

## Recommendations
What to sequence next, what epi information to collect, what to do now.
```

## Checklist before you share

- [ ] Key message first
- [ ] Numbers consistent between text, table and figure
- [ ] Excluded genomes and the reason are listed
- [ ] The negative control is mentioned
- [ ] Certainty words match the evidence
- [ ] No patient-identifying information
